title: Marathon Training (Standard)
description: After months of training… the big day is finally here. This is it—your first marathon. The crowd is buzzing, the adrenaline is high, and your heart is pounding with anticipation. Damn. It’s harder than you thought. Your pace begins to slip. Your breathing grows ragged. Your legs feel like they’re made of lead, and your form is starting to fall apart. Fatigue wraps around you like a fog. Every step takes more effort than the last. Then— Just as doubt starts to creep in— Someone breaks from the front of the pack and comes back toward you. They slow down… Match your pace… Hey There !
author: Mistress Shibby
